name: agent-fs-operations
body: The subdomain of an agent performing a filesystem mutation — delete, move, or copy — within the surface it owns. This is a bounded capability contract: the operation's meaning is inseparable from the per-path scope the agent holds, so the subdomain gathers both the operation and its scope. It is what a plan `deletes`/`renames`/`moves` task exercises, and it is distinct from the graph's own node/edge mutation surface (`apg node rm` / `apg edge rm`), which mutates graph nodes rather than files.
